name: Sparse Multi-Scale Grid
definition: A volume rendering and projection algorithm for SPH data that assigns particles to a hierarchy of grid levels based on their kernel smoothing length, deposits onto coarser grids, and collapses the hierarchy coarse-to-fine via upsampling to bound per-particle cost.
summary: The Sparse Multi-Scale Grid is a volume rendering algorithm for SPH data that uses a hierarchical grid structure to bound per-particle cost and provide large speedups for simulations with wide ranges of smoothing lengths.
